Columns.Name: 調査手配_自動手配待ち件数
調査手配_調査承諾待ち件数
調査手配_調査確定待ち件数

ExternalDatabaseInfo.CreateViewSql:
SELECT count(
        CASE
            WHEN (suba.auto_arrange_wait_flg = 1) THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS "調査手配_自動手配待ち件数",
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN (suba.survey_consent_wait_flg = 1) THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS "調査手配_調査承諾待ち件数",
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN (suba.survey_confirm_flg = 1) THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS "調査手配_調査確定待ち件数"
   FROM ((t_object_survey_arrange main
     JOIN m_survey_arrange_status suba ON ((main.survey_arrange_status_id = suba.survey_arrange_status_id)))
     JOIN t_object_survey subb ON ((main.survey_id = subb.survey_id)))
  WHERE ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM t_object_order
          WHERE ((t_object_order.object_order_id = subb.object_order_id) AND (t_object_order.active_flg = 1)))) AND ((suba.auto_arrange_wait_flg = 1) OR (suba.survey_consent_wait_flg = 1) OR (suba.survey_confirm_flg = 1)));
